body.title: fix(history): treat non-positive --max as unlimited
body.body:
**What this PR does / why we need it**:
`helm history --max 0` (or a negative value) currently prints an empty history, because the loop bound is `min(len(hist), client.Max)`. This treats a non-positive `--max` as "no limit" so the full history is shown.

**Special notes for your reviewer**:
Change is limited to `getHistory` in `pkg/cmd/history.go`.

**If applicable**:
- [ ] this PR contains user facing changes (the `docs needed` label should be applied if so)
- [ ] this PR contains unit tests
- [ ] this PR has been tested for backwards compatibility
